title: Claims Interest Rate Table: Delayed Arrears Installments on Income Annuities
content:
Interest on an arrears installment paid to the beneficiary of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract is added at a delay rate set by the state of issue and by the days that have passed since due proof of death was received (the received date of the death claim on file whose certified death certificate is shown as received), counted in calendar days to the payment date.

| State of issue | Days since due proof was received | Interest rate |
|---|---|---|
| Connecticut, Minnesota, New Jersey or New York | More than 30 | Group delay rate: **6% (0.0600)** |
| Connecticut, Minnesota, New Jersey or New York | 30 or fewer | Neither delay rate applies |
| Any other state | More than 60 | Other-state late rate: **5% (0.0500)** |
| Any other state | 60 or fewer | Neither delay rate applies |

The group late days are **30** and the other-state late days are **60**; "more than" means the day count must exceed the figure.

**Edges (hypothetical, due proof received 1 March, payment dates as shown).**

- New Jersey contract, paid 31 March (30 days): neither delay rate. Paid 1 April (31 days): 6%.
- Ohio contract, paid 1 April (31 days): neither delay rate. Paid 30 April (60 days): neither. Paid 1 May (61 days): 5%.
